paragraphs.source_en: While Hideyoshi lived, no man was ever permitted to enter the inner court without authorization. Kōetsu had once considered this only natural and thought nothing of it. Perhaps he had long understood how fickle women were by nature.

paragraphs.source_en: Seeking an audience with Lady Yodo merely to deliver a scabbard was hardly justifiable.
